scope: Nine already inspected development photos, grouped by conservative visible motif families and inherited source/duplicate links. Not unseen evaluation or topology-disjoint training. No QA-reserved inputs, deployed model or all-data model.

groups.reason: Keep regular, decorative, printed and bowed checker variants together despite different photographs and counts.
Conservatively keep star, small hearts, boar and rabbit inside surrounding frames/grids together; these are not independent topology families.

protocol.encoder: Freeze parameters AND BatchNorm statistics; train existing decoder and neutral new material head.
protocol.comparison: Synthetic-only control plus one mixed real/synthetic run per complete connected source/motif group; identical initial model, draw schedule and updates.
protocol.selection: Fixed final update; no held-out checkpoint selection or tuning.
protocol.metric: Body and globally exchangeable A/B identities, including missing-body joint errors and balanced per-material errors.
protocol.trainingTarget: Undegraded fractional synthetic paper coverage; ignore only two-pixel outer body band for material labels, preserve all body supervision.

followup.reason: Controlled printed-paper augmentation after the second pilot confused decorative ink with sheet identity.
followup.comparison: Same initial checkpoint, 240 updates, rate .001, grouped development folds and original sampling/reflection decisions as pilot v2. A separate seeded schedule substitutes one of three printed photos for half of sampled original synthetic views. Scene variants and real images are unchanged. No outcome-dependent parameter or checkpoint selection.
followup.successEvidence: Score body and observed/joint material errors, inspect all nine real-photo panels, then replay the same four full-pipeline arms with unchanged crop/geometry/paper gates. A pixel improvement alone does not authorize integration.
followup.limits: Only three procedural ink recipes and one seed; no topology expansion or unseen real-photo evaluation.
